Nhóm 6 riêng có Độ chi tiết = 'Danh mục chỉ số - theo giờ' + Mô tả BA 'Vốn hóa CỦA CHỈ SỐ / LNST CỦA CHỈ SỐ' + SQL tham khảo SUM/SUM GROUP BY marketCode — = SUM(Vốn hóa từng mã CÓ LNST TTM) / SUM(LNST TTM từng mã), GROUP BY Index Code + Trading Date — tính sẵn trên Fact Index Constituent Snapshot (cùng cơ chế idx_market_cap). GIÁ TRỊ LẶP LẠI trên mọi dòng Symbol cùng Index+Date — TUYỆT ĐỐI KHÔNG SUM/AVG lại cột này theo Symbol, dùng MAX()/ANY_VALUE() GROUP BY Index Code, Trading Date hoặc SELECT DISTINCT (không thể suy ra P/E của rổ từ AVG các P/E từng mã).
etl_logic: INNER JOIN security_trading_snapshot ON security_trading_snapshot.symbol = index_constituent_snapshot.symbol AND security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt → INNER JOIN (SELECT ics2.index_code, ics2.trading_dt, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN lnst.lnst_ttm IS NOT NULL THEN std2.close_price * lsi.outstanding_share_quantity END) / NULLIF(SUM(lnst.lnst_ttm), 0), 2) AS agg_val FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics2 INNER JOIN security_trading_snapshot std2 ON std2.symbol = ics2.symbol AND std2.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt LEFT JOIN listed_share_info lsi ON lsi.ticker_symbol = ics2.symbol AND lsi.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND lsi.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = ics2.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= ics2.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN (SELECT public_company.equity_ticker_symbol AS symbol, ics3.trading_dt, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(fr_value.data_val) END AS lnst_ttm FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics3 INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = ics3.symbol AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' LEFT JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.submission_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter IN (1,2,3,4) AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= ics3.trading_dt [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id ORDER BY pc_report_submission.rpt_year DESC, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter DESC] WHERE rn1 <= 4 INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCKQKD%' INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '60') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '21')) INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1' GROUP BY public_company.equity_ticker_symbol, ics3.trading_dt) lnst ON lnst.symbol = ics2.symbol AND lnst.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt GROUP BY ics2.index_code, ics2.trading_dt) idx_agg ON idx_agg.index_code = index_constituent_snapshot.index_code AND idx_agg.trading_dt = index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt → idx_agg.agg_val

FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics2 INNER JOIN security_trading_snapshot std2 ON std2.symbol = ics2.symbol AND std2.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt LEFT JOIN listed_share_info lsi ON lsi.ticker_symbol = ics2.symbol AND lsi.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND lsi.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_info sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = ics2.symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= ics2.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN (SELECT public_company.equity_ticker_symbol AS symbol, ics3.trading_dt, fr_value.data_val AS vcsh FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics3 INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = ics3.symbol AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' LEFT JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.submission_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= ics3.trading_dt [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id ORDER BY pc_report_submission.rpt_year DESC, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter DESC] WHERE rn1 = 1 INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_template_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCDKT%' INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '400') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '500')) INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1') vcsh ON vcsh.symbol = ics2.symbol AND vcsh.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt GROUP BY ics2.index_code, ics2.trading_dt) idx_agg ON idx_agg.index_code = index_constituent_snapshot.index_code AND idx_agg.trading_dt = index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt → idx_agg.agg_val
